citations.claim: Just before wall contact, energy ~904.8 J
After wall bounce energy jumps to 941.2 J
First violating step 63 energy 1002.99 exceeds allowed 1000.31
Speed at violation larger than pre-bounce 41.88

counterfactual.change: Changed only restitution e from 0.9978 to 0.5; otherwise identical shrunk scenario. Reduces bounce to inelastic, removing spurious energy gain, so energy_bound no longer violated.

explanation: Body with e~0.998 collides with thin vertical wall (0.3x5.2 at x=14.5). Despite near-elastic, kinetic energy increases from ~904.8J to ~941.2J after wall bounce (steps 12-20). Later ceiling bounce at step 62->63 increases energy from 988.15J to 1002.99J, exceeding E0+10%+5 limit 1000.31. Suggests collision impulse/positional correction double-counts in substep loop when restitution ~1, producing super-elastic restitution >1.
vision_note: In steps 60-62 the blue body travels near the top edge toward the top-right corner, then in step 63 it has bounced off the ceiling and is moving slightly downward. The thin vertical grey wall is far below and to the left and is not involved in this final bounce.
